metadata.agent_last_message:
The Rust CLI is implemented under [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml) and [output/src/main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs). It supports `inspect`, `inspect_marcxml`, `render_iso2709`, and `render_marcxml`, returns the required JSON envelope, normalizes `leader_template` on inspect, rebuilds ISO 2709 leader length/base address on render, rejects malformed ISO 2709 and MARCXML with structured `invalid_record` errors, and validates bibliographic field indicators, subfield codes, and repeatability from the embedded rules in [output/rules.txt](/workspace/output/rules.txt).

Verification completed with `cargo build --release`, `cargo test`, and end-to-end CLI runs for ISO 2709 render/inspect, MARCXML render/inspect, and an invalid-record case returning exit code `1` with `invalid_record`.
